name: Aphelion of Earth
description:
• [term:eclipse][blue]Eclipses[/blue][/term] the R.E.D. armor. You instead can read curse books, [red]sacrificing[/red] health to cast powerful [term:eldritch spells]eldritch spells[/term] which mark targets and [term:corrupt]corrupt[/term] your next punch. You can punch marked enemies from any range to siphon the mark and refund part of the [red]sacrifice[/red].

  • Sneak-right-click with a curse book to morph it into a [red]cursed tome[/red] which can hold 5 curse books.

[gray]At wit's end lie horrors of our own making[/gray]
discoveredBy: TheJ_Team, Winzor, ElectricSparx, and Schwump on 06/07/25
